title: Orchestrated model introduction roadmap and asset sync
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinated launch plan for adding a new model variant to the public catalog. Purpose: align engineering, design, docs, marketing, and support on assets, benchmarks, release notes, and rollout strategy. This ticket captures the end-to-end checklist, owners for each artifact, approval gates, and monitoring playbook for the first two weeks after launch.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog entry created and validated in staging with correct metadata and pricing guidance
Benchmark report published (latency, throughput, cost per 1k tokens) and reviewed by Research
Docs updated with examples, API schema changes, and migration notes
Release notes draft approved and scheduled for publication alongside product announcement
Launch checklist executed end-to-end and post-launch monitoring dashboard live
launch_checklist: Catalog / Portal: create staging entry with model tag, family, recommended use-cases, and version pinning options
Performance: run standard benchmark harness (p95 latency, throughput at 128/512 contexts, concurrency tests); include quantized and fp16 variants
Quality: run 3 prompt suites (safety, hallucination, domain-specific) and surface any regressions
Compatibility: validate SDKs (Python/Node) for streaming, function-calling, and structured output paths
Docs: update API reference, quickstart, code samples, migration guide, and troubleshooting section
Release notes: draft customer-facing notes, internal changelog entry, and legal/terms review if required
Design: prepare product screenshots, model card visual, and marketing hero assets
Marketing: draft launch blog post, social copy, and newsletter blurb; prepare embargo schedule
Support: update knowledge base articles and create triage playbook for frequent issues
Console & Observability: add per-model dashboards, cost/latency breakdown widgets, and trace hooks
Security & Compliance: verify KMS labels, data retention notes, and update audit log entries if behavior differs
Release gating: define canary % and fallback policy; add rollback criteria (error rate > 2% or latency p95 > 2x SLA)
Legal: export control check and model licensing summary included in catalog entry
Customer comms: prepare targeted emails for top 20 customers + public announcement cadence
Training:run 45m internal demo + FAQ session for sales/support
SDK release: tag client libraries with sample code updates and crosslink to release notes
Telemetry: ensure tokens and endpoints are instrumented for rollout metrics (request rate, errors, cost per token)
Post-launch review: schedule retrospective 10 business days after launch to capture defects and learnings
rollout_plan: Day -5: Final sanity checks in staging, signoffs from Research and Security
Day 0 morning: publish catalog entry to hosted; enable model for 5% of traffic (canary)
Day 0 + 2 hours: assess telemetry for errors and latency; if stable, increase to 25%
Day 1: validate user-facing docs and marketing links; begin newsletter distribution as scheduled
Day 3: open for general availability (100%) unless blocked by metrics
Week 1: daily standups for incident triage; feature flag on/off available to ops
Week 2: run post-launch evaluation and finalize consolidated benchmark in public docs
monitoring_and_kpis: p95 latency (ms) - target within +20% of benchmark baseline
error rate - target <0.5% for GA, immediate rollback if >2% during rollout
cost per 1k tokens - track against expected quantized/fp16 profiles
adoption: number of unique customers using model in first 30 days
support volume: number of new tickets referencing model (triage target <50 in first week)
release_notes_draft: New model variant added: 'rw-m-2.1' — optimized for balanced latency and quality. Highlights: 15% lower cost per token vs rw-m-2.0 on A100 fp16, improved throughput at 512 context lengths, streaming-compatible. Known limitations: minor quality regressions on long-dialog summarization (see Known Issues). See full benchmarks and migration notes in the docs PR.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: unexpected increase in hallucination rates for domain prompts — Mitigation: pin GA to 25% and run targeted prompt tests; disable for affected customers on request
Risk: SDK incompatibility for streaming clients — Mitigation: hold SDK release until PRs above are merged and include feature flags
Risk: cost spike for Dedicated customers using older autoscaling policies — Mitigation: notify account owners and provide recommended autoscale config
Risk: docs/marketing mismatch — Mitigation: internal pre-launch artifact review and signoff checklist
